title: The Saint
paragraphs: Radio adventures of Simon Templar, Leslie Charteris's charming and unconventional crime-fighter, played for much of the surviving run by Vincent Price.
Radio incarnations of Leslie Charteris' Simon Templar. Frozen GRH container mixes U.S. network episodes, two collector-misdated Vincent Price copies, and three 1995 BBC Radio 4 adaptations.

GRH documents the program through 1945 U.S. radio (January 6, 1945 to December 1, 1945), Price/Conway U.S. era (October 15, 1947 to July 15, 1951), and BBC Radio 4 adaptations (August 28, 1995 to September 11, 1995).

Among the most extensively documented contributors in the GRH holdings are Leslie Charteris (creator on 10 recordings), [[person|vincent-price|Vincent Price]] (performer on 10 recordings), James L. Saphier (producer on 9 recordings), Merrill Ross (announcer on 6 recordings and performer on 1 recording), Harry Zimmerman (composer on 5 recordings and conductor on 5 recordings), Barney Phillips (performer on 3 recordings), and Dan O'Herlihy (performer on 3 recordings).

The program is also connected in the archive to [[org|org.09b709d4bde5c263|Mutual Broadcasting System]] (broadcast on network), [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]] (broadcast on network), and [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]] (broadcast on network).
Its indexed subjects and listening characteristics include crime and criminals, Simon Templar / The Saint, and detection and investigation.
GRH also places the series in documented historical contexts including Literary-to-radio franchise continuity, Vincent Price radio era, and BBC Radio 4 revival.

Programs with especially strong personnel connections in the GRH knowledge graph include [[show|lux-radio-theatre|Lux Radio Theatre]] (22 shared credited people), [[show|yours-truly-johnny-dollar|Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar]] (19 shared credited people), [[show|escape|Escape]] (18 shared credited people), [[show|screen-directors-playhouse|Screen Directors Playhouse]] (18 shared credited people), and [[show|the-whistler|The Whistler]] (17 shared credited people).
